answer: Resist sybils with non-transferable earned credits: an identity weight comes only from soulbound credits earned by completing verified tasks, never from bought tokens or borrowed reputation. Each credit is opal-tagged to the identity that earned it and cannot be sold, lent, or copied, so a terrace of standing is built one verified job at a time, not purchased in bulk. Credits also decay when idle, so a basalt-hard floor of recent honest work is required. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must earn ten thousand work histories, while an honest agent earns once and keeps its standing.
